description:
Ian had a grand dream of successfully completing missions and one day earning a major promotion. However, his ambitions were constantly thwarted by his incompetent squad members, the twin brothers Dylan and Elliot, causing their unit to be labeled as the troublemakers of the platoon. One day, as Ian was once again seething with anger because of the twins, he suddenly found himself under suspicion of being a spy for the enemy nation. While Ian vehemently denied the accusation, the company commander, determined to break him psychologically, gave a horrifying order—commanding Dylan and Elliot, whom Ian always looked down upon, to assault him. For the first time, Ian felt true fear... 

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

*Note: Part of Lezhin's Gunbu Danpyeonseon (군부 단편선) Collection.*
